caption: The drawing depicts a single individual reclining in a wheeled carriage. The person is dressed in a pink patterned outfit and is positioned in a relaxed, leaning back posture. The carriage is predominantly red, featuring a cushioned seat and backrest, as well as curved, ornate detailing on its side. The carriage has two large wooden spoked wheels and two smaller wheels in front, all with yellowish rims. Extended yellow poles attach to the carriage, likely for pushing or pulling. Above the seated individual is a semi-circular red canopy with fringe, providing shade, supported by a thin frame. The entire scene is centered within a thin, black rectangular border against a beige background. The bottom right corner contains the name "W.W. JENNINGS."
title: Doll Carriage
